================================================================================
Alternate value with a closing paren after an expansion
================================================================================

echo "$1${2:+ (from $2)}"

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(program
  (command
    (command_name
      (word))
    (string
      (simple_expansion
        (variable_name))
      (expansion
        (variable_name)
        (concatenation
          (word)
          (simple_expansion
            (variable_name))
          (word))))))

================================================================================
Alternate value opening with a paren and a nested expansion
================================================================================

label="$remote${push_repo:+(from $push_repo)}"

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(program
  (variable_assignment
    (variable_name)
    (string
      (simple_expansion
        (variable_name))
      (expansion
        (variable_name)
        (concatenation
          (word)
          (simple_expansion
            (variable_name))
          (word))))))

================================================================================
Alternate value with a grouped expansion and text
================================================================================

echo "${2:+(x $2 y)}"

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(program
  (command
    (command_name
      (word))
    (string
      (expansion
        (variable_name)
        (concatenation
          (word)
          (simple_expansion
            (variable_name))
          (word))))))

================================================================================
Alternate value without parentheses stays one word
================================================================================

echo "${2:+x}"

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(program
  (command
    (command_name
      (word))
    (string
      (expansion
        (variable_name)
        (word)))))
